
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zhangmingcheng/p/19363446" title="发布于 2025-12-18 07:46">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">深入理解Linux IPIP隧道：原理、配置与实战</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2>引言</h2>
<p>在Linux网络虚拟化领域，隧道技术是实现跨网络通信的关键技术之一。特别是在容器化和Kubernetes环境中，Flannel等网络插件的早期版本广泛使用IPIP隧道来实现Pod间的跨节点通信。本文将深入探讨IPIP隧道的工作原理、配置方法及其在容器网络中的应用。</p>
<h2>1.什么是IPIP隧道？</h2>
<p>IPIP隧道是Linux内核<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>原生支持的一种三层隧道协议，全称为IPv4 in IPv4。其核心原理是在原始IPv4报文的基础上再封装一个IPv4报文头</strong></span>，从而实现报文在不同网络间的透明传输。<br>Linux内核支持的五种主要L3隧道协议包括：</p>
<ul>
<li>ipip：IPv4 in IPv4，在IPv4报文外封装IPv4报文；</li>
<li>GRE：通用路由封装，支持多种网络层协议的封装；</li>
<li>sit：IPv6 over IPv4隧道，用于IPv6报文在IPv4网络中的传输；</li>
<li>ISATAP：站内自动隧道寻址协议，主要用于IPv6过渡技术；</li>
<li>VTI：虚拟隧道接口，主要应用于IPSec VPN场景。</li>


</ul>
<h2>2.IPIP隧道的工作原理</h2>
<h3>2.1&nbsp;内核原生实现机制</h3>
<p>IPIP隧道完全由Linux内核网络栈实现，通过专门的内核模块（ipip.ko）提供功能支持。IPIP隧道的工作机制可以概括为以下几个步骤：</p>
<ol class="ybc-ol-component ybc-ol-component_1">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ol"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>原始报文准备</strong>：应用程序生成需要传输的原始IP数据包；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ol"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>路由决策</strong>：内核路由子系统根据目标地址判断数据包需要通过IPIP隧道发送；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ol"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>隧道封装处理</strong>：IPIP内核模块执行封装操作：</span></span></span>
<ul class="ybc-ul-component">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">在原始IP包外层添加新的IP头（外层IP头）；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">设置外层IP头的协议字段为4（表示IPIP协议）；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">源地址设置为隧道本地端点地址；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">目的地址设置为隧道远程端点地址；</span></span></li>


</ul>


</li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ol"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>物理网络传输</strong>：封装后的数据包通过底层物理网络传输到对端节点；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ol"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>协议识别与解封装</strong>：对端内核识别IPIP协议包，进行解封装处理；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ol"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>最终交付</strong>：原始报文被正确交付到目标应用程序。</span></span></li>


</ol>
<p><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">整个过程就像是将一封信（原始数据包）装入另一个信封（外层IP头）进行邮寄。</span></span></p>
<h3><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">2.2 封装格式详解</span></span></h3>
<p>原始IP包（内层）：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:html;gutter:true;">[原始IP头][TCP/UDP头][数据载荷]
</pre>
</div>
<p>IPIP封装后（外层）：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:html;gutter:true;">[外层IP头(协议=4)][原始IP头][TCP/UDP头][数据载荷]
</pre>
</div>
<h2>3.IPIP隧道与TUN设备对比　</h2>
<h3>3.1&nbsp;相同点：封装理念相似</h3>
<p>两者都基于"封装"的基本理念，但在实现层面有本质区别：</p>
<ul class="ybc-ul-component">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><strong><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp" style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">TUN设备将内核的IP包传递给用户空间程序进行封装处理；</span></span></strong></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><strong><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp" style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">IPIP隧道在内核空间直接完成IP-in-IP的封装。</span></span></strong></li>
</ul>
<h3>3.2 本质区别</h3>
<p><strong>（1）TUN设备的工作机制：</strong></p>
<ul class="ybc-ul-component">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">是用户空间与内核空间网络栈的桥梁；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">数据包通过/dev/net/tun字符设备传递；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">用户空间程序负责具体的封装逻辑（如OpenVPN的SSL封装）；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">涉及内核态与用户态的数据拷贝，性能开销较大。</span></span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>（2）IPIP隧道的工作机制：</strong></p>
<ul class="ybc-ul-component">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">完全在内核网络栈中处理，不涉及用户空间；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">数据封装/解封装由内核IPIP模块直接完成；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">无系统调用和上下文切换开销，性能更高；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">封装格式固定为IP-in-IP，无法自定义。</span></span></li>
</ul>
<h3>3.3 技术对比总结</h3>
<div class="hyc-common-markdown__table-wrapper" data-has-scroll="false">
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>特性</th><th>IPIP隧道（内核）</th><th>TUN设备</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>工作层面</strong>​</td>
<td>内核网络层（L3）</td>
<td>内核网络层（L3）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>数据处理</strong>​</td>
<td>内核IPIP模块封装/解封装</td>
<td>用户空间程序处理</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>性能表现</strong>​</td>
<td>高（无上下文切换）</td>
<td>相对较低</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>灵活性</strong>​</td>
<td>低（固定IPIP格式）</td>
<td>高（可自定义封装）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>使用场景</strong>​</td>
<td>简单点对点隧道</td>
<td>复杂VPN、自定义协议</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h2>4.IPIP隧道的正确配置方法</h2>
<h3>4.1 环境准备与内核支持&nbsp;</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:html;gutter:true;"># 检查IPIP内核模块是否已加载
lsmod | grep ipip

# 如未加载，手动加载IPIP模块
sudo modprobe ipip

# 验证模块信息
sudo modinfo ipip</pre>
</div>
<h3>4.2 创建和配置IPIP隧道</h3>
<p>标准配置命令格式：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:html;gutter:true;"># 创建隧道设备
sudo ip tunnel add &lt;隧道名称&gt; mode ipip remote &lt;对端IP&gt; local &lt;本端IP&gt; ttl 64

# 启用隧道设备
sudo ip link set &lt;隧道名称&gt; up

# 为隧道设备分配内网IP地址
sudo ip addr add &lt;内网IP/掩码&gt; dev &lt;隧道名称&gt;
</pre>
</div>
<p>完整配置示例：</p>
<p>节点A配置（服务器IP: 192.168.10.2）：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:html;gutter:true;">sudo ip tunnel add tun1 mode ipip remote 192.168.20.2 local 192.168.10.2
sudo ip link set tun1 up
sudo ip addr add 10.10.100.1/24 dev tun1
</pre>
</div>
<p>节点B配置（服务器IP: 192.168.20.2）：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:html;gutter:true;">sudo ip tunnel add tun2 mode ipip remote 192.168.10.2 local 192.168.20.2
sudo ip link set tun2 up
sudo ip addr add 10.10.100.2/24 dev tun2
</pre>
</div>
<p>连通性验证：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:html;gutter:true;"># 测试隧道连通性
ping 10.10.100.2

# 查看隧道接口状态
ip link show tun1
ip addr show tun1</pre>
</div>
<h2>5.Kubernetes网络插件中的实际应用</h2>
<p>在Kubernetes网络生态中，Flannel等网络插件的早期版本采用IPIP隧道实现Pod网络互通，其核心架构：</p>
<p><strong>（1）网络规划机制：</strong></p>
<ul class="ybc-ul-component">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">每个Kubernetes节点分配独立的Pod CIDR子网；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">节点间通过BGP或静态路由同步网络信息；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">IPIP隧道用于建立节点间的虚拟网络连接。</span></span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>（2）Flannel IPIP模式工作流程：</strong></p>
<ol class="ybc-ol-component ybc-ol-component_1">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ol"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>节点注册</strong>：节点启动时向etcd注册并获取Pod子网分配；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ol"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>隧道建立</strong>：根据集群节点信息自动创建IPIP隧道；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ol"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>路由同步</strong>：通过路由表确保数据包正确转发；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ol"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>跨节点通信</strong>：Pod间流量通过IPIP隧道透明传输。</span></span></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>（3）实际通信流程实例</strong></p>
<p>当Pod A（节点1，IP: 10.244.1.2）与Pod B（节点2，IP: 10.244.2.3）通信时：</p>
<ol class="ybc-ol-component ybc-ol-component_1">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ol"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>源节点处理</strong>：</span></span></span>
<ul class="ybc-ul-component">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">Pod A发送目标为10.244.2.3的数据包；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">节点1路由表指示通过IPIP隧道发送；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">IPIP模块封装数据包，外层指向节点2服务器IP。</span></span></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ol"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>网络传输</strong>：</span></span></span>
<ul class="ybc-ul-component">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">封装包经物理网络传输到节点2；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">中间网络设备仅能看到外层IP头。</span></span></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ol"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>目标节点处理</strong>：</span></span></span>
<ul class="ybc-ul-component">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">节点2内核解封装，恢复原始Pod通信包；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">数据包最终交付给Pod B。</span></span></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h2>6.IPIP隧道的优缺点分析</h2>
<h3>6.1 优势特性</h3>
<ul class="ybc-ul-component">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>内核原生支持</strong>：无需额外软件，系统稳定性高；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>配置简单直观</strong>：命令行配置清晰，运维成本低；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>性能表现优异</strong>：完全内核处理，无上下文切换开销；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>协议透明性好</strong>：支持传输各种IP协议数据；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>资源消耗低</strong>：内存和CPU占用相对较小。</span></span></li>
</ul>
<h3>6.2 局限性分析</h3>
<ul class="ybc-ul-component">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>安全性不足</strong>：缺乏加密机制，数据传输为明文；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>NAT支持差</strong>：在复杂NAT环境中配置困难；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>功能扩展性有限</strong>：相比VXLAN等协议功能单一；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>IPv6支持有限</strong>：主要针对IPv4环境设计；</span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content"><strong>MTU问题</strong>：封装增大包尺寸，可能引发路径MTU问题。</span></span></li>
</ul>
<h2>7.总结</h2>
<p>IPIP隧道作为Linux内核原生的简单隧道协议，其核心价值在于教会我们如何在现有基础网络（Underlay Network）之上构建逻辑独立的虚拟网络（Overlay Network）。这一理念正是现代云计算和容器网络的核心架构思想。</p>
<p><strong>（1）在Kubernetes网络中的实践意义：</strong></p>
<ul class="ybc-ul-component">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">一个Kubernetes集群可能包含成千上万个Pod，分布在不同的物理节点上 </span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">每个Pod都需要独立的IP地址，且所有Pod要能在扁平网络中直接通信 </span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">底层物理网络往往存在复杂性和隔离性限制 </span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ul"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">IPIP隧道等覆盖网络技术完美解决了这些问题 </span></span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>（2）技术演进视角：</strong></p>
<p>虽然现代云原生网络逐渐转向VXLAN、WireGuard等更先进的技术，但理解IPIP隧道的工作原理仍然是掌握网络虚拟化技术的重要基础。通过学习IPIP隧道，我们能够：</p>
<ol class="ybc-ol-component ybc-ol-component_1">
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ol"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">理解覆盖网络的基本概念和工作原理 </span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ol"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">掌握Linux内核网络栈的隧道实现机制 </span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ol"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">为学习更复杂的网络虚拟化技术奠定基础 </span></span></li>
<li class="ybc-li-component ybc-li-component_ol"><span class="ybc-li-component__dot-wp"><span class="ybc-li-component_content">深入理解容器网络插件的底层实现原理 </span></span></li>
</ol>
<p>IPIP隧道虽然在功能性和安全性方面存在局限，但其简单高效的特性在特定场景下仍具有实用价值，是学习Linux网络技术不可或缺的重要一环。</p>
